summary: Multiple waves of Russian strike UAVs targeted Kyiv and surrounding regions, with confirmed hits on infrastructure in Brovary including the EVA distribution center. DeepState confirmed enemy territorial advances near Svyatopetrivka, while Ukrainian forces from the 67th Brigade struck enemy personnel near Novomykolaivka. HUR Deputy Chief Skibitsky stated no ceasefire should be expected by year's end, as there are no signs Russia is prepared for one.
key_points: Multiple Russian strike UAVs targeted Kyiv region, Chernihiv region, and other areas with at least six drones tracked toward Slavutych and Brovary. (Source: @eRadarrua/105932)
The EVA distribution center in Brovary was hit, with the company warning of potential delays in goods delivery as a result. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32544)
DeepState map updated showing enemy advancement near Svyatopetrivka, indicating continued Russian territorial gains on the front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23749)
Pilots of the 67th Brigade 'Iron Falcons' struck enemy personnel near Novomykolaivka, confirming active combat operations in that sector. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23748)
HUR Deputy Chief Skibitsky stated no ceasefire should be expected by year's end, citing no signs Russia is prepared to stop fighting. (Source: @UkraineNow/83502)
Ukraine's Ambassador to Poland stated MiG-29 fighters from Poland cannot be used in combat without modernization, limiting them to training only. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32554)
Ombudsman Lubinets stated only 2-3% of mobilized Ukrainian men reach front lines, with the TCC mobilizing approximately 30,000 men monthly. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32542)
A Greek tanker carrying Russian oil was attacked in the Black Sea, amid ongoing disruptions to Russian oil exports through the region. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23747)

sections.executive_summary: Multiple waves of Russian strike UAVs targeted Kyiv and surrounding regions, with confirmed hits on infrastructure in Brovary including the EVA distribution center. DeepState confirmed enemy territorial advances near Svyatopetrivka, while Ukrainian forces from the 67th Brigade struck enemy personnel near Novomykolaivka. HUR Deputy Chief Skibitsky stated no ceasefire should be expected by year's end, as there are no signs Russia is prepared for one.

points: HUR Deputy Chief Skibitsky stated in an interview with RBC-Ukraine that no ceasefire should be expected by the end of the year, as there are no signs Russia is prepared for one. This assessment directly contradicts Zelensky's Office adviser Mikhail Podolyak's claim that an air ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine would end the active phase of the war, with only an agreement remaining to be reached. (Source: @UkraineNow/83502, @ukr_leaks_eng/32545)

Ombudsman Dmitry Lubinets stated that only 2-3% of mobilized Ukrainian men reach the front lines, with the rest either deserting or being refused admittance by military units. According to some estimates, the TCC mobilizes approximately 30,000 men monthly, raising serious concerns about the effectiveness of the mobilization pipeline. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32542)

Ukraine's public debt has reached $211 billion, described by Getmantsev, head of the Verkhovna Rada Committee on Finance, Tax, and Customs Policy, as a disaster for a country with a population of 20 million. Each resident owes more than $10,000, and the financial situation is on the brink of collapse even if all promised Western funds are received. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32558)

Ukraine's Ambassador to Poland Vasily Bodnar stated that MiG-29 fighters received from Poland cannot be used in combat in their current condition and require modernization. They can only be used for training, not for full-scale operations, limiting their immediate battlefield utility. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32554)

Ten soldiers from the Odessa Territorial Conscription Center are suspected of torturing and illegally detaining citizens, using tear gas, beatings, and running them over with a car. Eight victims have been identified, with one detainee choked, handcuffed, and forced to give up his phone password. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32556)

The ashes of OUN founder Yevgeny Konovalets were reburied at the National Military Memorial Cemetery, attended by Zelensky, Armed Forces Commander-in-Chief Drapaty, and other officials. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32549)

Russian State Duma deputy Khinshtein invited a hunter fined in Volgograd Oblast for shooting at UAVs to join the volunteer brigade 'BARS-Kursk,' stating that when Ukrainian drones attack Russian territories, such people should be welcomed rather than punished. (Source: @tass_agency/390901)

Maria Zakharova stated that Kyiv's cancellation of Grossi's planned visit to the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant on August 20-21 was a reckless step, claiming Kyiv's daily attacks on the ZNPP create a real threat of nuclear catastrophe in the center of Europe. (Source: @tass_agency/390892)

Russia and Myanmar signed a declaration on countering sanctions, and Myanmar has begun accepting Russian Mir payment cards, with the payment problem resolved according to Reshetnikov following Russian-Myanmar negotiations. (Source: @tass_agency/390894, @tass_agency/390867)

Russia opened a criminal case against FAZ journalist Michael Martens following his remarks about Russians, signaling continued pressure on foreign media. Separately, the deputy head of the Yabloko party was sentenced to up to 11 years in a penal colony for discrediting the army and spreading war fakes, stemming from debates where he insisted on the quickest possible end to the war. (Source: @tass_agency/390899, @UkraineNow/83499)

Novak instructed relevant agencies and oil companies to strengthen control over regional fuel supply, eliminate imbalances, prevent price spikes, and keep retail prices at gas stations under special control. (Source: @tass_agency/390896)

DeepState confirmed that enemy forces advanced near Svyatopetrivka, as shown on the updated DeepState map, indicating continued Russian territorial gains in the eastern sector. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23749)

Pilots of the 67th Separate Mechanized Brigade 'Iron Falcons' (ББС 67 ОМБр) struck enemy personnel near Novomykolaivka, confirming active combat operations and Ukrainian strike capabilities in the eastern front sector. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23748)

Reconnaissance UAVs were detected north of Chernihiv, and multiple strike UAV groups were tracked across Chernihiv Oblast, including strike and reactive drone groups from the 1st and 2nd groups, and reactive drones from the 3rd and 5th groups. (Source: @eRadarrua/105910, @eRadarrua/105940, @eRadarrua/105961)

Six UAVs were tracked past Slavutych along the Desna River heading toward Brovary, with three additional new UAVs launched from Bryansk Oblast along the border toward Slavutych, indicating a sustained drone assault vector from the north. (Source: @eRadarrua/105932, @eRadarrua/105957)
Reactive UAVs were tracked in Chernihiv region heading toward Slavutych, confirming the northern approach as an active drone corridor targeting the Kyiv metropolitan area. (Source: @kpszsu/73348)

Reactive UAVs were detected in southern Zaporizhzhia heading toward Dnipropetrovsk Oblast in the direction of Synelnykove and Vasylivka, indicating drone activity extending from the southern front into rear areas. (Source: @kpszsu/73358)
Reactive UAVs were tracked in Mykolaiv Oblast heading toward the settlement of Berezanka, confirming continued drone operations along the southern coastal axis. (Source: @kpszsu/73337)

A marshrutka in the suburbs of Zaporizhzhia was shown equipped with anti-drone protection, illustrating the reality of frontline territories where civilian transport requires defensive measures against aerial threats. (Source: @UkraineNow/83504)

An air alert was declared in Kyiv at 18:29 on August 18, 2026, as multiple waves of strike UAVs approached the capital region from multiple directions including Chernihiv, Poltava, and Bryansk Oblasts. (Source: @eRadarrua/105944, @eRadarrua/105949, @eRadarrua/105957)

Multiple reactive Shahed drones entered Brovary, with at least one confirmed to have struck the EVA distribution center, causing the company to warn of potential delays in goods delivery. Two reactive Shaheds were tracked toward Brovary on separate occasions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70395, @mon1tor_ua/70404, @ukr_leaks_eng/32544)

A reactive Shahed was tracked from a forest area toward Voskresenka, and another was tracked on Kyiv Oblast past Kagarlyk heading west, with additional drones tracked from Rzhyschiv toward Velyka Dymerka. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70400, @kpszsu/73326, @eRadarrua/105953)

Reactive UAVs were tracked across western Ukraine including through Ternopil Oblast toward Dubno in Rivne Oblast, and from Rivne Oblast toward Volyn, indicating a broad geographic spread of drone activity beyond the front lines. (Source: @kpszsu/73352, @eRadarrua/105942, @mon1tor_ua/70376)

Reactive UAVs were tracked on Cherkasy Oblast heading toward Kyiv Oblast, and in Vinnytsia Oblast heading toward Kopayhorod, showing multi-vector drone approaches to central Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/73323, @kpszsu/73347)

key_developments: Multiple waves of Russian strike UAVs targeted Kyiv and surrounding regions from at least five directions including Chernihiv, Poltava, Bryansk, Cherkasy, and Vinnytsia Oblasts, with confirmed impacts in Brovary. (Source: @eRadarrua/105932, @mon1tor_ua/70395)
The EVA distribution center in Brovary was hit by a drone, with the company warning customers of potential delays in goods delivery as a result of the strike. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32544)
DeepState map confirmed enemy territorial advancement near Svyatopetrivka, indicating continued Russian gains on the eastern front despite Ukrainian defensive efforts. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23749)

HUR Deputy Chief Skibitsky stated no ceasefire should be expected by year's end, directly contradicting Podolyak's claim that an air ceasefire would end the active phase of the war. (Source: @UkraineNow/83502, @ukr_leaks_eng/32545)

Only 2-3% of mobilized Ukrainian men reach front lines per Ombudsman Lubinets, with TCC mobilizing approximately 30,000 men monthly, raising serious concerns about mobilization effectiveness. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32542)

A Greek tanker carrying Russian oil was attacked in the Black Sea, amid ongoing disruptions to Russian oil exports following a drone attack on the Sheskharis terminal in Novorossiysk on August 14. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23747)

Poland's Deputy Defense Minister Tomczyk stated Poland is preparing for possible war and attacks on energy infrastructure, highlighting the SAN anti-UAV system as part of the Eastern Shield program. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32538)
sections.threat_assessment: The sustained multi-vector drone assault on Kyiv and surrounding regions demonstrates Russia's continued capability to project power deep into Ukrainian rear areas, with at least six UAVs tracked toward Slavutych and Brovary alone. The confirmed hit on the EVA distribution center in Brovary highlights the vulnerability of logistics infrastructure to aerial strikes. HUR Deputy Chief Skibitsky's assessment that no ceasefire is expected by year's end, combined with DeepState's confirmation of enemy advances near Svyatopetrivka, indicates continued active ground operations. The mobilization crisis, with only 2-3% of conscripted men reaching front lines, poses a significant structural threat to Ukraine's ability to sustain defensive operations.
sections.regional_response: Poland's Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk publicly stated Poland is preparing for possible war and no longer differentiates between realistic and unrealistic scenarios, including attacks on energy infrastructure, with the SAN anti-UAV system highlighted as part of the Eastern Shield program. Polish PM Tusk publicly addressed an attack on Ukrainian children in Bydgoszcz, with suspects detained by police. France is investigating possible Russian destabilization operations targeting potential 2027 presidential candidates including former PMs Edouard Philippe and Gabriel Attal, with the VIGINUM service tracking Russian information mechanisms Storm-1516 and Matriochka. Russia and Myanmar signed a sanctions counter-declaration and Myanmar began accepting Mir payment cards.
sections.intelligence_notes: The contradiction between Podolyak's optimistic ceasefire assessment and Skibitsky's pessimistic HUR assessment reveals internal divergences within Ukraine's leadership regarding conflict trajectory. Ukraine's public debt reaching $211 billion with per capita debt exceeding $10,000 creates severe fiscal sustainability concerns. The MiG-29 transfer from Poland being limited to training only due to lack of modernization reduces the immediate combat value of this transfer. The Odessa Territorial Conscription Center torture scandal, with eight identified victims, risks further undermining public trust in mobilization institutions already strained by the 2-3% front-line arrival rate. Russia's criminal case against FAZ journalist Michael Martens and the 11-year sentence for Yabloko's deputy head signal intensifying domestic repression.
